hero.title: John David TCHOMGUI
hero.description: Full Stack Web Developer and Data Analyst passionate about turning data into high-performing web solutions. Specialized in data analysis with Python, SQL and Power BI, and in building robust applications with React, Ruby on Rails and Node.js. I combine technical expertise in frontend/backend development with analytical skills to create intuitive interfaces and data-driven insights.
hero.description_continued: Trained at Le Wagon and Technofutur TIC, I am looking for new challenges combining web development and data analysis.

pitch.dev: From React components to Rails or Node.js APIs in production: complete, robust, carefully built web applications.
pitch.data: From data cleaning to Power BI dashboards: clear analyses that help people decide.

about.title: About
about.description1: Full Stack Web Developer and Data Analyst with dual technical expertise. Trained in web development at Le Wagon (Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL) and in data analysis at Technofutur TIC (Python, SQL, Power BI), I master the full web application development cycle as well as complex data analysis.
about.description2: Passionate about digital transformation, I combine frontend/backend development and analytical skills to build high-performing web solutions enriched by data. Autonomous and collaborative, I thrive both in teamwork and when leading projects on my own. My unconventional path reflects strong adaptability and continuous learning, essential in today's technology ecosystem.
about.lewagon: Web development: Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL
about.technofutur: Data analysis: Python, SQL, Power BI
